Context: 3. Stepping up

Stepping up of pay of departmental candidate from the DNI of direct recruit whose training period was counted for increment.In respect of direct recruits, the period of training before appointment counts for increments and this does not count for increment in case of departmental candidates. This may result in the departmental promotee's drawing less pay than a direct recruit junior to him.
